story.title: From Bitcoin workshops to a home for freedom tech
story.dek: Freedom Lab NYC makes powerful tools legible, useful, and social — without sanding away the cypherpunk principles that make them matter.

started.label: Where we started
started.title: Hands on from day one
started.body: We began as a Bitcoin-focused education group: helping New Yorkers build hardware wallets, run Bitcoin and Lightning nodes, mine bitcoin, and understand the systems they were using.

now.label: Where we are
now.title: A broader freedom-tech lab
now.body: Bitcoin remains the foundation. Around it, our scope now includes sovereign AI, encryption, self-hosted infrastructure, open-source hardware and software, and any practical tool that protects digital rights. Community growth has earned us a dedicated office inside a working West Village maker space — a foothold for workshops, coworking, and shared experimentation.

difference.label: What makes us different
difference.title: Beginner-accessible. Builder-credible.
difference.body: We translate cutting-edge, complex systems for laypeople while preserving a serious environment where advanced users and developers can test, use, and build together. Education is not the warm-up; it is the bridge between tools, users, and better tools.

next.label: Where we are going
next.title: A street-level Manhattan hub
next.body: Our next home is a permanent, unmistakably Freedom Lab building in central Manhattan: well branded, accessible from the ground floor, and globally visible. It will be a classroom, coworking home, and proving ground where the city’s best freedom-tech developers meet real users — and where AI helps more members become builders without losing sight of usability, usefulness, or rights.
